geometry: Rectangle [60+phase,130+phase] x [40+phase,120+phase], left wall of width lambda*(60+phase), nadir [0,80+phase]/ppm
selection: Original-coordinate left boundary, x<left+10 and y in [top+15,bottom-15]; every selected point retained
purpose: Compare actual segmentation/subpixel/wall correction under shared independent light fields, including exact light-matching wall controls
limitations: The four original bright-wall examples informed this development plan; this is not held-out qualification
Supplied camera and scale; independent linear image is passed to subpixel/wall stages; saved sRGB8 is used for actual segmentation
Gaussian point fields or exact uniform pixel means; no camera-tone inference, image noise, JPEG, rectification or postblur
No full physical camera-scene consistency, pose estimation, parallax, curve/CAD/export, real captures or fabrication qualification
Correction taper remains; local fit accuracy and final tapered boundary error are distinct
Synthetic elapsed times are observations, not whole-photo/browser latency qualification
